description_good_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/README.md -- the opening lines say what the software does.
interact_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/README.md and https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md -- how to get it, file issues and contribute.
contribution_requirements_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md -- Conventional Commits, sign-off, signed commits and the repository's full check are required.
floss_license_justification: The MIT license is approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).
floss_license_osi_justification: The MIT license is approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).
documentation_interface_justification: README.md documents the options, gate reasons, guard limits and log lines the mod exposes. (https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/README.md)
discussion_justification: GitHub Issues: searchable, addressable by URL, open to anyone, no proprietary client required.
english_justification: All docs are in English; issues and PRs in English are expected and supported.
maintained_justification: Actively maintained; see the commit history.
repo_track_justification: Repository on GitHub, which uses git. git tracks the changes, who made them, and when.
repo_interim_justification: Commits between releases are visible in git history.
repo_distributed_justification: Repository on GitHub, which uses git. git is distributed.
version_unique_justification: Each release has a unique m3l-prompt-optimizer--vX.Y.Z tag, and a published tag is never reused.
release_notes_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md -- human-readable, not a raw git log. CHANGELOG.md and each GitHub Release's notes.
release_notes_vulns_justification: No CVE has been assigned against this project. SECURITY.md's process commits to a published advisory if one is.
report_process_justification: Bug reports go through GitHub Issues: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/issues (see also https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
report_responses_justification: No bug report from outside the organization has been opened to date, so none is unanswered. SECURITY.md commits to acknowledging a vulnerability report within 7 days.
enhancement_responses_justification: Enhancement requests are triaged the same way as bug reports.
report_archive_justification: GitHub Issues is a public, searchable archive of every report and response: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/issues
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/SECURITY.md commits to acknowledgment within 7 days, under the criterion's 14-day bar.
build_justification: Nothing to build: the repository is used as committed source files.
test_justification: `claude plugin test .` runs every tests/*.test.ts, plus `node scripts/guard-break.mjs`, which requires the suite to fail when any safety check is removed.
test_invocation_justification: The standard command for this ecosystem is documented in CONTRIBUTING.md and .claude/CLAUDE.md.
test_most_justification: `node scripts/node-tests.mjs --coverage` measures line, branch and function coverage of hooks/ in the `quality` lane of https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/.github/workflows/verify.yml and fails below its bars (currently about 100% of lines and 96% of branches).
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/.github/workflows/verify.yml runs the suite on every push and PR.
test_policy_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md -- new behaviour needs tests and a fix needs a regression test.
tests_are_added_justification: Recent commits add or change tests alongside the behaviour they cover (tests/handle.test.ts, tests/guard.test.ts).
tests_documented_added_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md and the pull request template both state the policy.
warnings_justification: The TypeScript config is strict (https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/tsconfig.json, checked by `tsc -p .` locally). CI runs Biome with `--error-on-warnings`, CodeQL, actionlint and zizmor, and each fails the build on a finding.
warnings_fixed_justification: Findings from these tools fail the required `verify` or CodeQL check, so none is merged unfixed.
warnings_strict_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/biome.json turns on Biome's recommended rules and CI runs `biome ci --error-on-warnings`, so a warning fails the `quality` lane. `tsc -p .` is strict but runs locally, because it needs types the engine writes at install.
know_secure_design_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/docs/assurance-case.md maps the Saltzer and Schroeder principles to the code, and https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/SECURITY.md states the scope, secrets handling and accepted risks.
know_common_errors_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/docs/assurance-case.md's CWE table names the vulnerability types that apply and the mitigation for each.
crypto_published_justification: The project implements no cryptography; the host's HTTP client handles TLS.
crypto_password_storage_justification: The project stores no passwords for authenticating users.
delivery_mitm_justification: Distributed only through GitHub over HTTPS.
delivery_unsigned_justification: No hash is fetched over plain HTTP and used without a signature check.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/SECURITY.md commits to fixing a confirmed medium-or-higher vulnerability within 60 days; none is open.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: GitHub secret scanning and push protection are enabled, and .github/workflows/gitleaks.yml runs a second scan on every push and PR.
static_analysis_justification: GitHub CodeQL (default setup) analyzes every push and PR, more often than each release.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL's default query suite covers common vulnerability classes (CWE-mapped).
static_analysis_fixed_justification: CodeQL is a required check on `main`, so a confirmed finding is fixed before merge.
static_analysis_often_justification: CodeQL runs on every push and PR, not just daily.
dynamic_analysis_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/fuzz/ holds fast-check property tests that generate arbitrary prompts, API replies, status codes and failing hosts. The `quality` lane runs them on every push and pull request (https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/SECURITY.md, 'Dynamic analysis').
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: No memory-unsafe code: JavaScript or TypeScript on a managed runtime.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Each property asserts with `node:assert/strict` on every generated case, for example that the original prompt comes back, that no log line holds the prompt or the key, and that nothing throws (https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/fuzz/handle.fuzz.ts).
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: Dynamic analysis findings are fixed before merge: the property tests run in the required `verify` check. The first run found a negative `Retry-After` giving a negative retry wait, which `classify` now clamps, with a regression test (SECURITY.md, 'Dynamic analysis').
osps_ac_01_01_justification: The monte3l organization requires two-factor authentication for every member.
osps_ac_02_01_justification: The organization's default repository permission is read; write access is granted by hand.
osps_ac_03_01_justification: The `main` ruleset requires a pull request with a code-owner approval and the required checks, with an empty bypass list. Direct pushes are rejected.
osps_ac_03_02_justification: The `main` ruleset blocks deletion of the branch, with an empty bypass list.
osps_br_01_01_justification: No workflow interpolates event metadata into a script: values reach `run:` steps through `env:`. zizmor, which flags template injection, runs in CI and reports no findings.
osps_br_01_03_justification: No workflow uses `pull_request_target` or `workflow_run`. Pull-request workflows hold read-only tokens and no secrets, except the Gitleaks job (the org Gitleaks license) and the labeler, whose one job holds `pull-requests: write` and never checks out or runs pull request code.
osps_br_03_01_justification: Every official project URL (the repository, the issue tracker and the security advisory form) is served over HTTPS by GitHub. The docs site is served over HTTPS from Cloudflare.
osps_br_03_02_justification: The only distribution channel is GitHub, over HTTPS.
osps_br_07_01_justification: GitHub secret scanning and push protection are on, and .github/workflows/gitleaks.yml scans every push and PR. Both are required checks. `.claude/hooks/guard-secret-writes.mjs` also blocks writing a secret to disk.
osps_do_01_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/README.md is the user guide for every function the project offers.
osps_do_02_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md explains how to report a defect.
osps_gv_02_01_justification: GitHub Issues is open for discussion of changes and usage problems: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/issues
osps_gv_03_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md explains the contribution process, including that pull requests are limited to collaborators.
osps_le_02_01_justification: MIT, which meets the OSI Open Source Definition. The two bundled fonts are SIL OFL-1.1, also OSI-approved.
osps_le_02_02_justification: Released assets carry the same MIT license. Fonts keep OFL-1.1.
osps_le_03_02_justification: The release archive contains the LICENSE file. GitHub's source archive includes the root LICENSE.
osps_qa_01_02_justification: git history on GitHub records every change, its author and its date.
osps_qa_02_01_justification: The only package-managed dependencies are the CI tools in `.github/ci-tools/`, `.github/test-tools/` and `.github/deploy-tools/`, pinned by `package-lock.json`. The mod has no runtime dependencies. Every GitHub Action is pinned by commit SHA.
osps_qa_04_01_justification: The project is a single repository.
osps_qa_05_01_justification: The repository holds no generated executable artifacts.
osps_qa_05_02_justification: The only binary files are the two WOFF2 fonts vendored with m3l-design under `design/source/fonts/` (SIL OFL-1.1). They are not executable, and `design/SHA256SUMS` pins their hashes (checked in CI).
osps_vm_02_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-vulnerability gives the private advisory form and the 7-day acknowledgment target.
dco_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-certificate-of-origin: every commit needs a Signed-off-by trailer, enforced by the `DCO sign-off` lane of https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/.github/workflows/verify.yml, a required check on `main`.
access_continuity_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#access-continuity: a second organization owner holds access independently, and a release is a merge anyone with that access can make.
bus_factor_justification: Honestly 1 for authoring today; see https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#bus-factor. This is a Gold criterion and growing past 1 is on https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/ROADMAP.md.
documentation_current_justification: `node design/source/docs-kit/build.mjs --check` runs `scripts/doc-parity.mjs` in CI, which fails when the README's tables and quoted numbers differ from the code. https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md requires docs to change in the same pull request.
documentation_achievements_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/README.md shows the OpenSSF Best Practices badge (project 15705) and the Scorecard badge at the top.
accessibility_best_practices_justificati: The mod has no user interface of its own beyond Claude Code's debug log and one toast. The docs site uses the m3l-design system, which vendors the Atkinson Hyperlegible fonts.
internationalization_justification: The mod has no localizable end-user text beyond its debug-log lines and one toast. The prompts it refines keep their own language.
maintenance_or_update_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/SECURITY.md#supported-versions and #scope-and-duration-of-support: only the latest release gets a fix, and an older one is superseded when the next is published.
vulnerability_report_credit_justificatio: No vulnerability report has been resolved yet. https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/SECURITY.md#credit commits to crediting the reporter when one is.
coding_standards_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#coding-standards names strict TypeScript, Biome, Conventional Commits and the m3l-design Markdown rules.
coding_standards_enforced_justification: The `quality` lane runs `biome ci --error-on-warnings`, the `checks` lane runs the docs check and Commit lint checks every title and commit subject. All are required through `verify` or on their own (https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/.github/workflows/verify.yml).
build_repeatable_justification: The mod has no build step. The release tarball is `git archive` of the tagged commit, so its contents can be compared with the tag.
installation_standard_variables_justific: Installed as a Claude Code plugin; there is no install-location convention of the DESTDIR kind.
installation_common_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/README.md#quickstart: `claude plugin marketplace add monte3l/m3l-plugins` then `claude plugin install m3l-prompt-optimizer@monte3l`, the standard way to install a Claude Code plugin.
installation_development_quick_justifica: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#setup: clone, load the checkout with `claude --plugin-dir .`, then run the commands in the table that follows.
external_dependencies_justification: The mod has no external dependencies: it has no package manifest and loads as plain TypeScript. The tools CI installs are pinned in `.github/ci-tools/`, `.github/test-tools/` and `.github/deploy-tools/` with committed lockfiles, and each release's SBOM lists the vendored design system.
dependency_monitoring_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/.github/workflows/dependency-review.yml fails a pull request on a high-severity finding, Dependabot proposes updates (https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/.github/dependabot.yml) and GitHub CodeQL and Dependabot alerts cover the rest.
updateable_reused_components_justificati: Committed lockfiles pin the CI tools, Actions are pinned by SHA and the vendored m3l-design copy is replaced by `bin/sync-design.sh` from a release (https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/design/README.md).
interfaces_current_justification: The mod uses the current Messages API and the Claude Code plugin interface, and `claude plugin validate --strict .` runs in CI against the engine version pinned in `.github/ci-tools/`. Dependabot proposes engine bumps.
automated_integration_testing_justificat: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/.github/workflows/verify.yml runs the unit tests, the mutants, the coverage run and the property tests on every push and pull request, and reports pass or fail per lane.
regression_tests_added50_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#scope-of-a-pr makes a regression test a MUST. A recent example is the negative `Retry-After` fix with its test in tests/client.test.ts.
test_statement_coverage80_justification: `node scripts/node-tests.mjs --coverage` in the `quality` lane of https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/.github/workflows/verify.yml requires 90% of lines, 80% of branches and 90% of functions in hooks/. It currently reports 100% of lines, about 96% of branches and 97% of functions.
crypto_algorithm_agility_justification: The project implements no cryptography and writes no network-protocol code. The host's HTTP client handles TLS to api.anthropic.com.
crypto_credential_agility_justification: The project implements no cryptography and writes no network-protocol code. The host's HTTP client handles TLS to api.anthropic.com.
crypto_used_network_justification: The project implements no cryptography and writes no network-protocol code. The host's HTTP client handles TLS to api.anthropic.com.
crypto_tls12_justification: The project implements no cryptography and writes no network-protocol code. The host's HTTP client handles TLS to api.anthropic.com.
crypto_certificate_verification_justific: The project implements no cryptography and writes no network-protocol code. The host's HTTP client handles TLS to api.anthropic.com.
crypto_verification_private_justificatio: The project implements no cryptography and writes no network-protocol code. The host's HTTP client handles TLS to api.anthropic.com.
signed_releases_justification: Each release carries a Sigstore build-provenance attestation of its tarball, the bundle as a `.sigstore.json` asset and a CycloneDX SBOM; see https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/SECURITY.md#verifying-releases.
version_tags_signed_justification: Release tags are created by release-please and are unsigned, though the commits they point at are signed. Only suggested.
input_validation_justification: The gate bounds each prompt, the parser accepts only two reply shapes and the guard checks every rewrite before it is used (https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/hooks/gate.ts, https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/hooks/guard.ts). Property tests in fuzz/ feed all three arbitrary input.
hardening_justification: Every workflow resets permissions to the minimum per job, checkouts use `persist-credentials: false`, every Action is pinned by SHA, no workflow uses `pull_request_target`, and zizmor runs in CI (https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/.github/workflows/). Releases are immutable.
contributors_unassociated_justification: Both contributors belong to the monte3l organization; see https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#gold-level-criteria-this-project-does-not-meet. Gold only.
two_person_review_justification: The `main` ruleset requires a code-owner approval for every new change, but the criterion counts changes and the first commits predate the ruleset; see https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md. Gold only.
osps_ac_04_01_justification: Default workflow permissions are read (a repository setting), and every workflow sets `permissions:` at the top, read-only or empty. A write scope is granted per job only where needed.
osps_ac_04_02_justification: Permissions are set per job, never inherited from a broad default. Each write scope sits in the job that needs it, with the reason beside it: `assets` in https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml, `analysis` in scorecard.yml and the labeler.
osps_br_01_02_justification: No workflow puts a branch name into a script. Workflows read values through `env:` and none builds a command from `github.head_ref` or a ref name.
osps_br_01_04_justification: Collaborator input reaches a shell only through `env:`, and no workflow takes a comment or other free text into a script. The pull request title in commit-lint.yml arrives through `env:`.
osps_br_02_01_justification: Each release has a unique `m3l-prompt-optimizer--vX.Y.Z` tag and a unique semantic version (https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#versioning), and immutable releases stop a tag from being reused.
osps_br_02_02_justification: Each release asset carries the version in its name: `m3l-prompt-optimizer-<version>.tar.gz`, its `.sigstore.json` bundle and its `.cdx.json` SBOM.
osps_br_04_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md, written by release-please from Conventional Commits, and each GitHub Release's notes. Human-readable, not a raw git log.
osps_br_05_01_justification: The mod has no dependencies. The CI tools are listed in `package.json` files with committed lockfiles, and the SBOM of each release lists the vendored design system.
osps_br_06_01_justification: Each release has a Sigstore build-provenance attestation, the `.sigstore.json` bundle as an asset and an SBOM attestation; https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/SECURITY.md#verifying-releases shows how to verify them.
osps_br_07_02_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/SECURITY.md#secrets-and-credentials states what the project does not store, inventories every secret with its scope, and sets rules for storing, accessing and rotating.
osps_do_03_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/SECURITY.md#verifying-releases gives the `gh attestation verify` commands for a release's tarball.
osps_do_03_02_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/SECURITY.md#verifying-releases says the attestation shows the archive came from this repository's `release.yml` on the tagged commit, and how to compare it with the tag.
osps_do_04_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/SECURITY.md#scope-and-duration-of-support states what is covered and that a release is supported until the next one is published.
osps_do_05_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/SECURITY.md#scope-and-duration-of-support states that a superseded release gets no fixes, security fixes included, and that the remedy is to update.
osps_do_06_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#scope-of-a-pr: the mod takes no runtime dependency, a new CI tool is pinned by lockfile and needs a stated reason, and Dependabot and Dependency Review keep them current.
osps_do_07_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#setup and the 'Before opening a PR' table explain how to load the checkout and run every check.
osps_gv_01_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles names the maintainer and the co-owner, the only people with access.
osps_gv_01_02_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles lists each role and its responsibilities.
osps_gv_03_02_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#coding-standards and #before-opening-a-pr name the standards and the checks every change must pass.
osps_gv_04_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#granting-access is the policy: only an owner grants access, with the other owner's agreement, after a track-record and identity check. Access starts at triage and is reviewed yearly.
osps_le_01_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-certificate-of-origin: every commit needs a Signed-off-by trailer, enforced by the `DCO sign-off` required check.
osps_qa_02_02_justification: Each release carries a CycloneDX 1.6 SBOM, `m3l-prompt-optimizer-<version>.tar.gz.cdx.json`, attested with actions/attest and verifiable with `gh attestation verify --predicate-type https://cyclonedx.org/bom`.
osps_qa_03_01_justification: The `main` ruleset requires the verify, Dependency Review, CodeQL, Gitleaks and DCO sign-off checks, with strict status checks and an empty bypass list.
osps_qa_04_02_justification: No release is built from more than one source repository. The vendored m3l-design copy lives in this repository.
osps_qa_06_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/.github/workflows/verify.yml runs the full suite on every push and pull request, and the required `verify` check reports pass or fail for each lane.
osps_qa_06_02_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#test-environments-and-how-tests-run lists each kind of test, where it runs, what triggers it and how to read the results.
osps_qa_06_03_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#scope-of-a-pr: new behaviour needs tests and a fix needs a regression test.
osps_qa_07_01_justification: The `main` ruleset requires one approving review from a code owner who is not the author, with stale approvals dismissed on push and an empty bypass list.
osps_sa_02_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/docs/architecture.md#external-interfaces and the Settings, gate, guard and log tables in https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/README.md.
osps_vm_04_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/SECURITY.md#response-process: the advisory is published after a fix. No advisory has been needed so far.
osps_vm_04_02_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/SECURITY.md#vulnerabilities-that-do-not-affect-the-project sets the policy for an OpenVEX statement. None has been needed so far.
osps_vm_05_02_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/SECURITY.md#remediation-thresholds: a critical or high finding blocks the pull request that introduces it, and the maintainer does not merge a release pull request while one is open.
osps_vm_05_03_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/.github/workflows/dependency-review.yml fails a pull request on a high-severity finding or a license outside the allow-list. It is a required check.
osps_vm_06_02_justification: CodeQL default setup analyzes every push and pull request, and the CodeQL check is required on `main`. It fails on new alerts of error severity or of critical or high security severity.
build_reproducible_justification: The mod has no build step. The release tarball is `git archive` of the tagged commit, so its contents can be compared with the tag.
code_review_standards_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-review lists what a reviewer checks, and every pull request needs a code-owner approval.
require_2FA_justification: The monte3l GitHub organization requires two-factor authentication for every member; see https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#account-security.
secure_2FA_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#account-security requires an authenticator app or a hardware key and rules out SMS.
copyright_per_file_justification: Copyright is recorded in https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/REUSE.toml, checked by `reuse lint` in CI, not by a header in each file. Only some scripts carry an inline SPDX header. Gold only.
license_per_file_justification: The license is recorded in https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/REUSE.toml, checked by `reuse lint` in CI, not by a header in each file. Gold only.
test_statement_coverage90_justification: `node scripts/node-tests.mjs --coverage` reports 100% line coverage of hooks/ and requires 90%. Node reports lines, which stands in for statements.
test_branch_coverage80_justification: The same run reports about 96% branch coverage of hooks/ and requires 80% (`scripts/node-tests.mjs`, the `quality` lane of verify.yml).
security_review_justification: No security review has been signed off beyond the maintainers' own assurance case in https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-prompt-optimizer/blob/main/docs/assurance-case.md. Gold only.
hardened_site_justification: The docs site sends a Content-Security-Policy with `frame-ancestors 'none'`, Strict-Transport-Security and X-Content-Type-Options, but not X-Frame-Options. Gold only.
